bullets.text: Two crew members, a Danish and a Greek national, were killed after firefighting helicopters collided in Greece; a British pilot and another Greek crew member survived the incident.
At least 13 people were killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza, which Israel stated targeted military operatives, after Hamas reportedly agreed to a disarmament deal.
The EU plans an urgent meeting of interior ministers to discuss the Ceuta crisis, as divisions remain within the bloc over the mass crossing of migrants into the Spanish territory from Morocco.
New South Wales Opposition Leader Kellie Sloane is under increased scrutiny as the ICAC continues its hearings, with a senior parliamentary colleague expected to provide testimony.
Murrumbidgee Council in NSW is set to trial a four-day working week, which will provide staff with 52 long weekends annually starting next year.
An exclusive report reveals a record number of First Nations people died in NSW prison custody last year, raising concerns among advocates that this year's figures could be even higher.
AstraZeneca is reportedly in talks to acquire Bristol Myers Squibb, a deal that would create one of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies with an estimated value of $400 billion.
America's largest companies are reporting strong profits, with S&P 500 groups on track for their best earnings in five years, even as consumers face higher costs.
Italy's Prysmian is in advanced discussions to acquire Atkore Inc., an electrical manufacturing company based in the US.
